headline: Almondz Global Securities submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Voting results from AGM now on record
summary: Almondz Global Securities Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing following the conclusion of the company's shareholder meeting. For an Indian retail investor holding this micro-cap stock, the filing confirms the formal adoption of resolutions without operational surprises.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural filing with no immediate impact on share price.
